# draftsharks.com API

Scraper for DraftSharks.com fantasy football data including rankings, player profiles, strength of schedule, depth charts, and news.

## Install / import

```python
from parse_apis.draftsharks_com_api import DraftSharks
```

## Operations

Call these on the client's collection accessors (e.g. `client.<collection>.<op>(…)`) or via active-record navigation on returned objects — see [`example.py`](./example.py) for the exact call spelling. List operations return a lazy `Paginator`.

| Call | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `client.teams.list_sos(position: Optional[SosPosition \| Literal['k', 'qb', 'rb', 'te', 'wr']] = None, limit: Optional[int] = None, max_fetches: int = 1000)` | `Paginator[Team]` | Fetch strength-of-schedule data for a given position, including weekly matchups, projected stats, and opponent details for all 32 NFL teams. Returns the current NFL week and full season schedule data. Single-fetch result set; the iterator yields one page. |
| `client.players.list(depth: Optional[Depth \| Literal['analysis', 'rankings']] = None, scoring: Optional[Scoring \| Literal['ppr', 'non-ppr', 'half-ppr']] = None, position: Optional[str] = None, is_dynasty: Optional[IsDynasty \| Literal['true', 'false']] = None, league_type: Optional[LeagueType \| Literal['standard', 'superflex']] = None, limit: Optional[int] = None, max_fetches: int = 1000)` | `Paginator[Player]` | Fetch the player rankings table for a given scoring format and league type. Returns up to 500 players with projections, ADP, injury risk, and tier information. Paginates as a single page. Some parameter combinations (e.g. dynasty + analysis + non-ppr) may not be supported upstream and will return an upstream error. Single-fetch result set; the iterator yields one page. |
| `player.profile()` | `PlayerProfile` | Fetch full player profile details including bio, weekly projections, season projections, consensus projections, scoring configurations, and dynasty trade values. Requires the player's numeric ID. |
| `client.articles.list(limit: Optional[int] = None, max_fetches: int = 1000)` | `Paginator[Article]` | Fetch recent fantasy football news articles with summaries and related player information from DraftSharks. Returns the latest articles available on the news page, typically 20 items. Single-fetch result set; the iterator yields one page. |
| `client.depth_charts.get(team_slug: Optional[str] = None)` | `DepthChart` | Fetch team depth charts showing player positions and depth order for offense, defense, and special teams. Each position lists players from starter to backup in order. |

## Errors

| Error | Raised when | Carries |
|---|---|---|
| `ResourceNotFound` | Player ID or team slug does not exist (404/410 from upstream) | `player_id` |

Runtime errors (`RateLimitError`, `UpstreamError`, `PaginationLimitError`, …) are importable from `parse_apis` and can occur on any call.

> **Note.** Some params accept an enum whose corresponding output field is raw `str`/`list` (the wire value isn't bound to the enum). Enum members never compare equal to raw strings — compare such output values against `member.value`, or use plain string literals.
